en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a stone relief, framed in an arched, brick-like border. The relief depicts a stylized lion attacking another animal beneath it, with a bird (possibly an eagle) perched above, and a serpent forming a loop at the top. Ornamental foliage appears above the bird. The postcard is devoid of color and any modern graphical elements, focusing solely on the ancient carved stone.
